exposure: type of skin incision for caesarean section
cohort: 22 women who had a solid organ transplant
finding: Solid organ transplant recipients have a high rate of caesarean section, and those with simultaneous pancreas and kidney transplants may be at increased risk of bladder injury during the procedure.
mod_finding: Patients with solid organ transplants have a higher rate of CS and SPK patients may be at a higher risk of bladder injuries during CS.
